hooks.text: 单手武器可自由分配左右手组成套装
hooks.excerpt: All weapons are one handed, wear Sword, Daggers, Wands or Shield on any hand to create a unique build. (Shields are only left handed) There are over 50 weapons, each with unique skills.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 异常状态可作用于Boss并叠加祝福改造
hooks.excerpt: Apply status effects on any enemy, including bosses. Such as Bleed, Poison, Burn, Freeze, Shock, Choke, Shatter, Life Splash, Darkness or Light Struck. Find tons of blessings, unique items that modifies your character builds.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三张随机地图串联事件商店祭坛与铁匠
hooks.excerpt: Traverse through 3 randomly generated maps. With unique enemies, backgrounds and random encounters. Find random encounters that give unique rewards. Find chests full of blessings. Visit a shop where you can acquire weapons, gear and blessings. Boost your health, mana or stamina by praying to the statue. Use a blacksmith to smelt spare gear to upgrade your equipment.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
